title: Smoke test: redact regression tests
instructions: Add tests/test_redact.py with unittest cases: for each pattern in hub/redact.py one positive sample that must become [REDACTED], plus negative samples of ordinary text that must stay unchanged. Delegate writing the tests to Codex (codex_implement), have Codex run them (codex_test), then request codex_review. Run `python3 -m unittest tests.test_redact` yourself to verify. Do not change hub/redact.py unless a test reveals a real bug; if so, describe it.
acceptance: Codex calls listed in the report
